prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity north-star desktop web app direction comp, 1536x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design the first viewport for UniMind, a bilingual source-grounded university study platform, as an Annotated Atlas visual world derived from scientific plates, tracing overlays, numbered marginalia, and evidence callouts. This is an authenticated Operate-mode product interface, not a marketing page.
Scene/backdrop: bright near-white vellum field, graphite structure, deep teal active controls, restrained vermilion annotations, ultramarine navigation marks.
Subject: a student has selected a synthetic Human Medicine “Cardiovascular Module”. Show the full authorized catalog path in a disciplined outer margin and an evidence-aware unit workspace as the main plate. Include safe readiness, 12 approved sources, quota, language, and clear navigation to overview, chat placeholder, Studio placeholder, and quiz placeholder without implying unimplemented features work.
Composition/framing: a single full-canvas annotated plate owns the viewport, not a sidebar dashboard and not a pile of cards. The module title and primary “Open workspace” action are integrated into the plate. Transparent annotation layers connect source/status callouts to the exact workspace regions they explain. Numbered marginal tabs show the catalog hierarchy. Include correctly rendered bilingual labels: “Cardiovascular Module”, Arabic “وحدة الجهاز القلبي الوعائي”, “Approved sources”, Arabic “المصادر المعتمدة”, “Ready”, Arabic “جاهز”. Isolate English medical terms clearly inside RTL copy.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished production UI mockup; precise editorial-scientific plate, layered vellum, fine but accessible rules, restrained workhorse typography, strong hierarchy.
Interaction implication: tabs and callouts have obvious keyboard focus; selected, ready, unavailable, and warning states differ by wording, icon, and shape.
Constraints: equally credible on phone and desktop even though this comp is desktop; accessible contrast; serious academic tone; configuration-driven language; synthetic data only; no claims; no real university logos; no tiny illegible text; no browser chrome; no device frame; no watermark.
Avoid: medical illustration of organs, hospital software, generic LMS, chatbot-first shell, gamification, sepia paper, decorative bookish clichés, glassmorphism, gradients, oversized marketing heading.
